title: What number fits in each blank?
description: Four sentences each have one blank, and both sides must have the same value. The side that can be worked out is found first, and then the blank is found and checked.
teaching_notes: One idea: when two expressions are equal, find the value of the side you can work out, then ask what the blank must be. Check each blank by putting it back.

video_script.why: The child uses the value of an expression to find a missing number.
video_script.substitution: Work out the side with no blank. Then find the number that gives the same value on the other side.
video_script.anchor: Four sentences, each with one blank
video_script.payoff_line: The blanks are eleven, eight, four and nine

final_answer.spoken: the blanks are eleven, eight, four and nine

never_show: a blank filled with a number that does not fit
video_script.design: One idea: equal expressions have the same value, so a blank is found from the value. Assumes the four operations. Uses the method of the solved examples on value. The four sentences stay on the board all video.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; four sentences with one blank each: (a) 13 + 4 = ____ + 6, (b) 22 + ____ = 6 × 5, (c) 8 × ____ = 64 ÷ 2, (d) 34 − ____ = 25

marks.book: the title card arrives: From your book
marks.ask: the four sentences appear and each blank glows

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Four sentences each have one blank, and both sides must have the same value. What number goes in each blank?

beats.on_screen: the four sentences stay on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: a balance with two sides; one side shows a worked value, the other side shows a blank

marks.plan: the side with no blank glows

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>We solve it the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='plan'/>Work out the side with no blank. Then find the number that gives the same value on the other side.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, four sentences, and each has one blank.

beats.on_screen: To find: the number in each blank

marks.find: the words the number in each blank are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the number for each blank.

marks.one: the value 17 is written, then the blank is filled

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, the first sentence. Thirteen plus four is seventeen, so blank plus six must be seventeen. Eleven plus six is seventeen, so the blank is eleven.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, the second sentence. Six times five is thirty, so twenty two plus blank must be thirty. <bookmark mark='fill'/>Twenty two plus eight is thirty, so the blank is eight.

<bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, the third sentence. Sixty four divided by two is thirty two, so eight times blank must be thirty two. <bookmark mark='fill'/>Eight times four is thirty two, so the blank is four.

marks.four: the sentence is written, then the blank is filled

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step four, the last sentence. Thirty four minus blank must be twenty five. Thirty four minus nine is twenty five, so the blank is nine.

marks.check: each blank is filled in and both sides show the same value

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>Step five, check by putting each number back. Seventeen, thirty, thirty two and twenty five each match on both sides.

marks.ans: the four numbers are placed in the blanks and the answer is boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The blanks are eleven, eight, four and nine.
